title: Storage design: one page system that can live on JSONL today and Cloudflare later

chat.text: An Opus design page, no code: a Store base class with the small interface a page needs, concrete stores for JSONL (today, the reference), JSON snapshot, local SQLite, D1, Durable Objects and R2 archive; which page kind uses which; the sync rule that avoids two writers; Cloudflare pricing with a monthly estimate for this repo's volume; every past Cloudflare ask prioritized with its status; and the first slice written as a brief ready to spawn.
